te: Following up ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly resolutions, and planning visits to Laos, Russia and Vietnam
se: The meeting (members only) assigned the compilation of follow-up on the resolutions of the 46th ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA) General Assembly, took note of the visit to Perak State, Malaysia, on 15 January 2026, approved the schedule for a visit to the Lao People’s Democratic Republic following the Nakhon Phanom study visit, and considered travel to bilateral meetings in the Russian Federation and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam under the annual plan
it: Following up implementation of the resolutions of the 46th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
Results of the visit to Perak State, Malaysia, 15 January 2026 (following the southern border study visit)
Visit to the Lao People's Democratic Republic, 10–11 February 2026
Bilateral meetings in the Russian Federation (30 March–5 April 2026) and in Vietnam (June–July 2026)

te: Security agencies brief the committee on the border situation regarding Kawthoolei
se: The meeting invited agencies concerned to provide information on the border security situation following the announced establishment of a “Kawthoolei Republic” or other groups near the Thai border, covering threat assessment, readiness of personnel and equipment, Thailand’s position in international forums, plans for displaced persons, and transnational drugs, weapons and human trafficking, and agreed to write asking the government to consider special pay for personnel serving in the fighting on the Thailand–Cambodia border
it: Border security following the announced establishment of a “Kawthoolei Republic”: threat assessment, measures to protect sovereignty, plans for displaced persons, and transnational crime
Asking the government to consider special pay for personnel serving in the field during the fighting on the Thai–Cambodian border
Academic forum “Veterans: from the battlefield to a new decade of careers”, 17 February 2026
Committee secretary and honorary advisers appointed

te: Starting the 2026 work: following the border situation, preparing a visit to Nakhon Phanom, and matters from residents on the Thai–Cambodian border
se: At the first meeting of 2026, the meeting considered matters from the Senate Meets the People project, lower Northeast, about Thailand–Cambodia border areas that are still fragile, and referred them to the agencies concerned; approved a study visit to Nakhon Phanom Province (upgrading the Ban Pho Sai relaxed trade point to a permanent border crossing); followed up the work of all 3 subcommittees; and assigned a study of the border situation following the announced establishment of a “Kawthoolei Republic”
it: Matters from the Senate Meets the People project, lower Northeast, Surin and Buriram Provinces: Thailand–Cambodia border areas where safety is still fragile
Study visit to the Mekong River Patrol Unit and the upgrade of the Ban Pho Sai relaxed trade point, Ban Phaeng District, Nakhon Phanom Province, to a permanent checkpoint, 9–10 February 2026

Subcommittees: a proposal to raise allowances for personnel on field duty at the border, a discussion with the Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Thailand, setting up a working group on weapons law, and a study visit to the southern border
The border situation after the announced establishment of a “Kawthoolei Republic”, which may affect national security
Travel to bilateral meetings in the Russian Federation (annual plan)

te: Government agencies to be heard on the defence industry: urgent matters, legal obstacles and proposals
se: Meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 09.30, Committee Meeting Room CA 433, floor 4, Parliament House. Agenda: information, facts and views on the overall defence industry, urgent matters that need government support, legal obstacles, and problems and proposals of the agencies concerned, with representatives of the relevant government agencies invited; and progress of the working group. (The Senate has not yet published the summary of this meeting, so this text is the agenda from the meeting notice, not the meeting's resolutions.)
it: Overview of the defence industry, urgent matters needing government support, legal obstacles, and agencies' problems and proposals
Progress of the working groups

te: Pre-meeting video · Government agencies to be heard on the defence industry: urgent matters, legal obstacles and proposals
Report on counter-drone system requirements considered, and work planned for fiscal year 2027
se: The meeting considered the study report on the analysis of requirements for counter-unmanned aircraft systems completed by the working group, noted the summary report of the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry" and the progress of 5 working groups, and set its work plan and study visit plan for fiscal year 2027
it: Study report: analysis of requirements for counter-unmanned aircraft systems
Summary report of the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry"
Work plan of the subcommittee and its working groups, fiscal year 2027

te: Meeting summary video · Report on counter-drone system requirements considered, and work planned for fiscal year 2027
Summary of work in 2026: 5 working groups, 5 study visits and a defence industry seminar
se: The meeting considered its summary of work in 2026, in which it set up 5 working groups (counter-drone systems, the space domain, law, a security innovation centre, and national interests in air and space), made 5 study visits, such as to Wing 3, the Royal Thai Air Force Space Operations Center and GISTDA, and held the seminar "Upgrading Thailand's Defence Industry"
it: Summary of the subcommittee's work, 2026

te: Annual work report to be completed promptly, and 4 views from industry received
se: The meeting noted that the committee has asked for study reports to be completed promptly for submission to the Senate in this session, together with a summary of work for 2026. It considered 4 views from the Defence Industry Association: views on the draft Space Affairs Act, views on the draft firearms law, and a request for the facts on news of drone purchases from abroad and of a drone factory being set up
it: Study reports and the summary of work for 2026 to be completed promptly, as requested by the committee
4 views from the Defence Industry Association (the draft space affairs law, the draft firearms law, and a request for the facts on news about drones)
